mapper.sql: a.id, a.student_id, a.coach_id, a.appoint_date, a.time_slot, a.status, a.remark, a.create_time, s.name AS student_name, c.name AS coach_name FROM appoint a LEFT JOIN student s ON a.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN coach c ON a.coach_id = c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appoint(student_id, coach_id, appoint_date, time_slot, status, remark, create_time) VALUES(#{studentId}, #{coachId}, #{appointDate}, #{timeSlot}, 0, '', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE a.coach_id = #{coachId} AND a.appoint_date = #{appointDate} AND a.time_slot = #{timeSlot} AND a.status IN (0, 1)
